messages:
auditor_maya: Quick follow-up from the ISO/SOC2 fieldwork: we need binding artifacts for an RBAC tweak that touched the serviceAccount `inference-proxy` on 2025-03-12. Specifically: (a) change PR/commit, (b) exact deploy window, (c) KMS Decrypt events against alias rdw-inference-key around the deploy, and (d) vuln triage or operational notes related to the change. Where do we pull these from?

kd_oncall: Hi @auditor_maya — PR + CI + CloudTrail + k8s audit should cover it. We have an exporter that bundles these.

rachel_infra: PR is github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4620, merge commit 9c8d2f3 (merge time 2025-03-12T15:41:12Z). CircleCI job 8241 kicked the rollout: `kubectl apply -f rollout-20250312.yaml` at 2025-03-12T15:41:45Z.

tom_sec: For KMS, query CloudTrail for eventName=Decrypt with requestParameters.keyId containing `rdw-inference-key` for 2025-03-12T15:30:00Z..2025-03-12T16:00:00Z. Splunk example: 
```
index=cloudtrail eventName=Decrypt "rdw-inference-key" | rename userIdentity.principalId as principal | table _time, principal, requestParameters.encryptionContext, sourceIPAddress
```

auditor_maya: Will encryptionContext have anything we set to tie the call back to the service account? CloudTrail principal might show node role.

tom_sec: Yes — we populate encryptionContext.service_account when the pod requests decrypt. The principal in CloudTrail will be the assumed-node role but encryptionContext shows `service_account:inference-proxy`. That linkage is what auditors want.

rachel_infra: CI artifact `deploy-artifact-20250312-1541.json` saved at s3://redwood-audit/ci-artifacts/2025/03/12/deploy-artifact-20250312-1541.json (contains image digest, git sha, manifest with serviceAccount). K8s audit snippet saved at s3://redwood-audit/k8s-audit/2025/03/12/sa-binding-1541.json.

kd_oncall: I'll run exporter with timeframe and keys: `redwood-audit export --from 2025-03-12T15:30:00Z --to 2025-03-12T16:00:00Z --keys rdw-inference-key --include-ci --include-cloudtrail --include-k8s --output s3://redwood-audit/evidence/1747129999-inference-proxy-bundle.tar.gz`

security-bot: Evidence export started by kd_oncall. Job eexp-9f3b queued.

auditor_maya: For the narrative mapping to controls, can you map artifacts to SOC2 CC6.1 and ISO A.9 (user access & change control)? Also indicate any redactions or PII removed.

tom_sec: Will do. Artifact mapping checklist I'll include in `mapping.txt` inside the bundle. Redactions: node hostnames/IPs redacted, but principal ARNs, encryptionContext, serviceAccount names, and timestamps retained. Checksums attached.

rachel_infra: There's also vuln ticket INFSEC-1122 linked from the PR. Summary: patched grpc minor to fix CVE-2025-0456 after dependency scan flagged it; mitigation applied in same deploy. I'll add triage summary `INFSEC-1122-summary.txt` to bundle.

auditor_maya: Can you also include a short causal timeline (10-30s resolution) tying PR -> CI -> k8s rollout -> decrypt event timestamps so we can show the decrypts were triggered by the new pod?

kd_oncall: Exporter writes `timeline.csv` with `_time,artifact,notes` at 10s granularity when available. I'll also append an oncall attestation file `attestation.txt` signed by me.

security-bot: Evidence export complete: s3://redwood-audit/evidence/1747129999-inference-proxy-bundle.tar.gz sha256: a3f7...

auditor_maya: Got it, thanks. I'll validate and raise any follow-ups. Please leave the forensic pod env snapshot unredacted for internal review (we'll keep it internal).

tom_sec: noted — pod env snapshot is under s3://redwood-audit/forensics/pod-env-20250312-1541.json (internal-only).

kd_oncall: Marking this thread resolved from our side. Reopen if auditor requests deeper log correlation or raw CloudTrail output.

auditor_maya: Acknowledged — appreciate the quick turnaround :thumbsup:
